title: Industry applications — architecture and landscape editions
geometry: Newly authored parametric CadQuery solids. No downloaded meshes.
status: Digitally checked, ready for a first print and application-specific evaluation; physical trials pending.
preview_colors: Optional painted finish. Single-material print files; preview-only hardware is labeled.

sources.purpose: User-supplied category inspiration; not evidence of demand for these designs.
Context for distinguishing a non-clinical demonstration from patient-specific devices.

products.title: Courtyard office campus
products.use: Physical presentation of building massing, courtyard layout and landscape relationships.
products.client: Architecture studios, property presentations, design-review workshops.
features: Three stepped wings with recessed windows
Courtyard, benches, paths, eight trees and three massing cars
products.print: Single connected model. Flat base on bed. Start with PLA, 0.4 mm nozzle, 0.12–0.16 mm layers, 3 walls and 10–15% infill.
products.limits: Fictional 1:200 concept. Small details are enlarged for printing. No structural/construction information.

products.title: Terraced garden and pavilion
products.use: Physical landscape presentation showing terrain levels, circulation, planting and water features.
products.client: Landscape architects, urban-design teams, real-estate presentations.
features: Four contour terraces and eight entrance steps
Recessed pond, connected paths, twelve trees, benches and bollards
products.print: Single connected model. Flat base on bed. Start with PLA, 0.4 mm nozzle, 0.12–0.16 mm layers, 3 walls and 10–15% infill.
products.limits: Fictional concept at nominal 1:200 scale; modeled dimensions are display millimeters. Pond is a recess, not a water vessel.

products.title: Datum drill jig
products.use: Repeated two-hole positioning on nominal 25 mm stock using a datum stop and separate steel bushings.
products.print: Print in the supplied flipped pose, fences upward. PETG trial: 0.2 mm layers, 5 walls, 40–60% infill; tune to the actual clamping duty.
products.hardware: Two flanged steel drill bushings, nominal OD 10 / ID 6 / flange OD 16 mm; M5 bolts and washers or suitable clamps. Confirm sleeve length and retention.
products.limits: Use steel bushings, retain them and clamp the work. No drill-wear or load-life validation. Preview bushings are reference-only and excluded from printable files.

products.title: ControlPod prototype housing
products.use: Mechanical fit and ergonomic mockup for a handheld controller or benchtop interface.
features: 42 × 18 mm display aperture and two button apertures
products.print: Two parts on the supplied plate: body upright, lid exterior face down. PLA or PETG trial, 0.16–0.2 mm layers, 4 walls, 20–30% infill.
products.hardware: Four M3 bolts and nuts, PCB screws matched to the board. Select bolt lengths after confirming the stack. Retain nuts during lid placement.
products.limits: Electronics not supplied. Display/button positions are illustrative. No ingress rating or electrical certification.

products.title: Gusseted sensor bracket
products.use: Example replacement mounting bracket for a threaded M18 cylindrical sensor.
features: 18.5 mm circular seat with self-supporting roof
products.print: Base down. PETG trial: 0.2 mm layers, 5 walls, 40–60% infill. Material and process require confirmation for the machine environment.
products.hardware: Sensor mounting nuts and washers; two M5 mounting bolts and washers.
products.limits: Example dimensions only. Confirm machine fit, temperature, vibration, tightening torque and loads; no safety-critical rating.

products.title: Dental training arch
products.use: Non-clinical display prop illustrating an arch and crown forms.
products.client: Education/demo settings, subject to review of the illustrative anatomy.
features: Fourteen generic crowns with differentiated forms
products.print: Base down. PLA display prop, 0.12–0.16 mm layers; 3 walls and 15–20% infill. Ordinary filament is not specified for clinical contact.
products.limits: Not patient-specific or anatomically validated. Not for intraoral use, aligner manufacture, surgical guidance, diagnosis, treatment or prosthetic fitting.
